## What

Move `EventSystem`, the event bus factory, and the global store and event store caches out of `e3-ciphernode-builder` into a new `e3-event-system` crate. The events, evm, keyshare, net, sync, zk-prover, dashboard, cli, and entrypoint crates now use the event runtime without depending on the builder. The multi-node `CiphernodeSystem` harness moves from `e3-test-helpers` into `crates/tests`, its only user, so unit tests of other crates no longer compile the builder. Node behavior does not change.

Also removes items that had no callers: the builder's `with_in_mem_datastore` injection (and `EventSystem::in_mem_from_store`), and the harness's `reconnect_node`.

## What

Split the two longest startup functions into named steps, without behavior change. `setup_evm_system` (241 → 51 lines) loops over chains and calls `chain_readers`, `attach_interfold`, `attach_ciphernode_registry`, and `attach_slashing_manager`. `setup_extensions` (217 → 106 lines) calls `router_builder`, `recover_zk_actors`, `dkg_timing`, and `accusation_manager`. Router recipients are added in the same order, and error and log text is unchanged.

Also removes leftovers of the phase split: reuse `Storage.repositories`, derive `Default` for `ChainParameters`, stop returning the discarded `CiphernodeSelector` address from `setup_sortition`, and inline the one-caller `wait_for_evm_gateways`.

{stack}
This PR was previously the whole refactor; its earlier parts are now PRs 1–3 above. The CodeRabbit comment on the crate graph edges is addressed in PR 1.
